hero.title: Deep-well pumps, supplied and serviced since 2013.
hero.subtitle: Supplied, installed and maintained across Egypt. {count} exclusive agencies, one point of contact, and a service team on call.

servicesPage.title: Our Integrated Services
servicesPage.subtitle: We offer integrated engineering solutions in supply and maintenance of well equipment and pumping systems using state-of-the-art technologies.
servicesPage.supplyDesc: We are committed to supplying the best original equipment and products with warranty and professional installation.
servicesPage.maintenanceDesc: Integrated workshops and a mobile maintenance fleet to guarantee that your wells operate at 100% efficiency.

pump-supply.title: Supply & Installation of Pumps
pump-supply.short: Supply and installation of all types of submersible pumps and centrifugal pumps of various capacities.
pump-supply.desc: We provide supply and installation services for Submersible Pumps and vertical/horizontal centrifugal pumps from major international brands. Our engineering team studies the water well to determine precise requirements for production rate, height, and selects the most appropriate pump to ensure maximum operational efficiency and lowest energy consumption.

panel-design.title: Design & Supply of Electrical Control Panels
panel-design.short: Design and supply of smart electrical control and protection panels to safeguard motors and pumps.
panel-design.desc: We design and assemble electrical control panels (Control Panels) of various capacities and operating systems (Star-Delta, Soft Starter, Inverter). We use the highest quality global electrical components to ensure full protection for pumps and motors against phase loss, overcurrent, or under-voltage.

marine-cable-supply.title: Supply of Marine/Submersible Cables
marine-cable-supply.short: High-quality insulated submersible cables resistant to water and pressure in deep wells.
marine-cable-supply.desc: We provide fully insulated submersible/marine cables made of materials resistant to water, high pressure, and heat, specifically designed for heavy-duty work in deep wells. Our cables ensure efficient power transmission without voltage drop and complete safety against electrical leakage.

well-pipe-supply.title: Supply of Deep Well Pipes
well-pipe-supply.short: Iron and reinforced plastic (uPVC) pipes customized for wells to resist corrosion and high pressure.
well-pipe-supply.desc: Supply of metal well pipes and reinforced plastic pipes (uPVC) customized for submersible wells. Our products are highly resistant to corrosion, rust, soil pressure, and tension, ensuring smooth water flow and the integrity of the well structure for decades.

spare-parts-supply.title: Supply of Spare Parts
spare-parts-supply.short: Thrust bearings and motor winding wire, supplied from stock for rewinding and overhaul work.
spare-parts-supply.desc: Supply of pump and motor spare parts: silicon carbide (SiC) thrust bearings for sandy, heavily loaded wells, and enamelled copper winding wire in the full range of sizes for rewinding submersible and surface motors. Parts are stocked and supplied as genuine items.

pump-maintenance.title: Pumps Maintenance
pump-maintenance.short: Rehabilitation and maintenance of submersible and horizontal pumps and changing genuine spare parts.
pump-maintenance.desc: We offer comprehensive maintenance and repair services for all types of submersible and surface pumps. Our services include technical inspection, pressure and flow tests, machining of damaged parts, and replacing bearings and mechanical seals with genuine spare parts to restore factory efficiency.

motor-maintenance.title: Motors Maintenance
motor-maintenance.short: Rewinding of submersible and surface electric motors and heat insulation treatment.
motor-maintenance.desc: Fully equipped workshops for rewinding and maintaining electric motors (low and medium voltage). We use high-quality copper wires and highly durable, heat-resistant insulation materials, and run insulation and dynamic balance tests to ensure stable performance and longer motor life.

panel-maintenance.title: Electrical Control Panels Maintenance
panel-maintenance.short: Troubleshooting, upgrading control systems, and replacing damaged electrical components.
panel-maintenance.desc: Our engineers and technicians inspect and maintain electrical control panels, diagnose faults, program protection devices and inverters, and replace damaged breakers and contactors to ensure continuous, automatic, and safe station operation.

productsPage.title: Products Showcase
productsPage.subtitle: We provide a wide range of high-quality, reliable industrial equipment and machinery for agriculture, water, and construction sectors.

motor-hitemp.title: Kurlar Submersible Motors
motor-hitemp.desc: Genuine Kurlar submersible motors (6"-8"-10"), rewindable and rated for continuous operation up to 60°C. High-temperature PBN winding wire, water-cooled construction, and a stainless steel shaft deliver a longer service life and lower operating cost than standard motors, manufactured in ISO 9001 certified facilities.

pump-submersible.title: Kurlar Stainless Steel Submersible Pumps
pump-submersible.desc: Genuine Kurlar KP stainless steel submersible pumps. Their corrosion-resistant AISI 304 and AISI 316 construction delivers long service life and reliable performance for demanding agricultural irrigation, industrial water supply, and groundwater dewatering applications.

pump-cast-stainless.title: Cast Stainless Submersible Pumps
pump-cast-stainless.desc: Genuine Kurlar KSX cast stainless steel submersible pumps (6"-8"-10"). All wetted parts — diffusers, impellers, and suction/discharge chambers — are cast in AISI 304 stainless steel for outstanding corrosion resistance, high efficiency, and long service life. Suitable for both horizontal and vertical installation; full AISI 316L construction available on request.

pump-rovatti.title: Rovatti Borehole Pumps
pump-rovatti.desc: Italian-built borehole pumps from Rovatti Pompe, in cast iron and cast steel with AISI 316 stainless available, in the 8" and 10" sizes most Egyptian wells are cased for. Each size comes in two hydraulics: radial for high head — the 8" reaches 675 m — and mixed-flow for high volume, where the 10" carries up to 420 m³/h. The check valve is built into the delivery bowl.

pump-rovatti-surface.title: Rovatti Surface Pumps
pump-rovatti-surface.desc: Italian-built surface pumps from Rovatti Pompe, carried as a complete range: single-stage and multistage centrifugal electric pumps in horizontal and vertical execution, bare-shaft surface pumps for coupling to a motor or engine, and waste water electric submersible pumps with single-channel, double-channel and vortex impellers. Suited to irrigation, water supply and pressure boosting, industrial service water and drainage.

pump-tormac-surface.title: Tormac Surface Pumps
pump-tormac-surface.desc: Tormac surface pumps, carried across the range: TCCH close coupled units, TEH and TEC horizontal end-suction centrifugals, THSC horizontal split case pumps for high flows, and TV vertical multistage pumps for high head from a small footprint — with matched induction motors supplied alongside. Used for irrigation, water supply and pressure boosting, and industrial and building services, in 50 Hz.

pump-panelli-sx.title: Panelli Submersible Pumps
pump-panelli-sx.desc: Italian-built submersible pumps from Panelli, in cast iron and cast steel as well as micro-cast AISI 304 stainless, with 8" and 10" the sizes most Egyptian wells are cased for. The 8" 180 SX covers 78 to 140 m³/h at 10 to 150 HP, and the 10" 230 SX covers 200 to 280 m³/h at 25 to 340 HP. Semiaxial impellers suit mid-to-high flows at moderate head, which is the shape of most irrigation and water-network duty. Tell us the well's yield and depth and our engineers will size the pump for it.

motor-franklin.title: Franklin Electric Submersible Motors
motor-franklin.desc: Franklin Electric submersible motors in 8" and 10". The 8" runs 40 to 200 HP at 50 Hz, with a Hi-Temp 75 build rated to 75°C ambient for hot or slow-flowing wells, tripping before an overheat burns the winding. The 10" is rewindable at 175 to 250 HP on 380-415 V. Both use the Sand Fighter seal system, and both are available in full 316 stainless or 904 L.

motor-panelli.title: Panelli Submersible Motors
motor-panelli.desc: Water-filled rewindable submersible motors from Panelli of Italy, in 8" and 10" to match the SX pump ends, with the wider range running from 0.37 kW up to 300 kW. Cast iron and stainless steel bodies are both available to suit the water the motor will sit in.

elec-control-panel.title: Electrical Control Panels
elec-control-panel.desc: Pump and motor control panels built up in El Waha's own workshop, in three starting types: inverter (VFD) for variable-speed control, soft starter for a gradual ramp up to full speed, and star-delta for stepped starting on larger motors. Each panel is specified against the motor it will run, and brings the starting current down so the well starts without the shock that shortens motor and pump life. Housed in a floor-standing steel enclosure with MCCB incoming protection, copper busbars, DIN-rail control gear, and door-mounted indication.

elec-inverter.title: NOVO Inverter
elec-inverter.desc: An advanced, high-efficiency solar-driven pump controller with Dynamic MPPT technology, delivering stable performance, intelligent power management, and long-life reliability for agricultural, industrial, and off-grid water pumping applications. Supports solar-only or hybrid solar + grid operation with automatic switching.

pipe-upvc-column.title: Astral Pipes
pipe-upvc-column.desc: Genuine Astral Bore-Well lead-free column pipes for submersible pumps. Manufactured with square-thread couplers, EPDM 'O' Ring seals, and a double stainless steel stud pin locking system, they are 100% free of lead and heavy metals, UV-stabilised, and rigorously tested for leak-proof, long-lasting performance in deep well and borehole installations.

thrust-bearing-heavy.title: ALKA Thrust Bearings
thrust-bearing-heavy.desc: Genuine Alka AP+ Series silicon carbide (SiC) ceramic thrust bearings, engineered for challenging deep-well applications where sand, ferrous debris, or high thrust loads exceed the capacity of conventional bearings. Retaining full strength at temperatures up to 1100°C and validated through in-house and field testing, they deliver outstanding wear resistance and reliability where standard stainless steel or carbon bearings fail.

winding-wire-voltson.title: Voltson Wires
winding-wire-voltson.desc: Genuine Voltson EXCELGRIP poly-wrapped winding wire for rewinding submersible pump motors. Built on EC grade ETP copper of 99.95% minimum purity and wrapped in bi-axially oriented polypropylene, it holds its insulation up to 120°C and is heavily annealed so it lays into stator slots without cracking. Every coil is high-voltage tested at 3.5 kV rms and the range is tested to IS 8783, in sizes from 0.40 to 2.40 mm² on 500 m and 1000 m coils.

cable-submersible.title: Submersible Motor Cables
cable-submersible.desc: Water-resistant, copper-conductor cables designed to safely power submersible motors in deep well installations.

cable-flat-untel.title: Untel Cable
cable-flat-untel.desc: Genuine Üntel H07VVH6-F PVC flat power and control cable, rated 450/750V, used for power and control wiring inside pump control panels, starter cabinets, and deep well pump stations. IPX8 tested by TÜV for permanent submersion up to 10 bar (100 m), UV resistant, and flame retardant.

agentsPage.title: Our Agents & Partners
agentsPage.subtitle: El Waha is the authorized agent and distributor for prominent international brands in Egypt, ensuring you get 100% genuine products with warranty.

astral-pipes.name: Astral Pipes
astral-pipes.title: uPVC Column & Well Casing Pipes
astral-pipes.desc: A global Indian leader in the production of high-tensile uPVC column pipes and casing pipes for water wells. Known for high load capacity, easy installation, and leak-proof joints.

jee-pumps.name: JEE Pumps
jee-pumps.title: Industrial & Submersible Pumps
jee-pumps.desc: One of the largest manufacturers of submersible and centrifugal pumps of various capacities for industrial, agricultural, and municipal applications, characterized by superior hydraulic efficiency.

pmc.name: PMC
pmc.title: Electrical Control Components & Panels
pmc.desc: An international brand specializing in manufacturing electrical control panel components, transformers, and highly reliable stabilizers designed for harsh industrial conditions.

kurlar.name: Kurlar
kurlar.title: Heavy-Duty Submersible Motors
kurlar.desc: A prominent brand producing stainless steel and cast iron submersible motors with excellent thermal insulation and heat resistance to guarantee long-term operation.

alka.name: ALKA Thrust Bearing
alka.title: Submersible Motor Thrust Bearings
alka.desc: The leading manufacturer and supplier of high-quality thrust bearings for submersible motors, ensuring reduced friction and absorption of vertical mechanical loads in deep wells.

novo.name: NOVO
novo.title: Solar Pump Inverters
novo.desc: A solar-pumping specialist supplying dynamic-MPPT inverters that run submersible pumps on solar power alone or in an automatic solar-plus-grid hybrid, for agricultural, industrial and off-grid water pumping.

tormac.name: Tormac
tormac.title: Submersible Pumps & Motors, 50 Hz
tormac.desc: A submersible pump and motor manufacturer whose 50 Hz product range we carry as exclusive Egyptian agent, documented across a 124-page pump catalogue and a 42-page motor catalogue.

untel.name: Üntel
untel.title: Submersible Power & Control Cable
untel.desc: A cable manufacturer whose H07VVH6-F flat power and control cable is TÜV-certified for permanent submersion to 10 bar, used for wiring inside pump control panels and deep-well pump stations.

supportPage.title: Aftersales Support
supportPage.subtitle: A well that has stopped is not a technical fault — it is a growing season at risk. Our mobile maintenance fleet responds around the clock in every Egyptian governorate.
supportPage.stat1Label: Response, every day of the year
supportPage.servicesDesc: Whatever we supply, we maintain. Our workshops carry their own testing, calibration and rewinding equipment, so repairs happen under our supervision rather than at a third party.
supportPage.processDesc: Four steps from the phone call to the well running again.
supportPage.step1Desc: Tell us the well, the equipment and what it is doing. Phone or WhatsApp, day or night.
supportPage.step2Desc: An engineer attends the site, or the unit comes into the workshop for testing on our own equipment.
supportPage.step3Desc: Rewinding, machining, part replacement and recalibration — with genuine spare parts from our agencies.
supportPage.step4Desc: The unit is tested against its duty point before it goes back down the borehole.
supportPage.warrantyDesc: We are the exclusive Egyptian agent for {count} international manufacturers, and we carry their spare parts in our own warehouse. That is the difference between a repair that takes a day and one that waits on an import.
supportPage.ctaTitle: Need a well back in service?
supportPage.ctaDesc: Call us directly, or send the details and an engineer will come back to you.

dinner-2025.desc: El Waha for Wells and Pump Services hosted its annual dinner in 2025, bringing together our team, partners, and clients to celebrate another year of growth and shared success across Egypt's agricultural sector.

aboutPage.title: Deep-Well Engineering Since 2013
aboutPage.subtitle: Supplying, installing and maintaining deep-well pumping equipment in Egypt since 2013
aboutPage.p1: El Waha for Wells and Pump Services began in 2013 as a small 200 m² maintenance centre in Giza, run by a team of five. Today the company operates a 3,000 m² warehouse and workshop with a team of more than 80 specialist engineers and technicians, covers every governorate in Egypt, and has delivered more than 230 agricultural projects.
aboutPage.p2: We equip deep water wells end to end: column pipes, insulated submersible cable, submersible pumps and motors, and control panels and voltage stabilizers designed for each individual well. Because no two wells are alike, our engineers size every installation against the well's own yield and head before anything is supplied — so the pump that goes down the borehole is the one that will draw the least energy and last the longest in service. That difference shows up in the electricity bill every month, and in how often the irrigation stops.
aboutPage.p3: We hold exclusive Egyptian agencies for {count} international manufacturers and work to ISO 9001. Our workshops carry current testing, calibration and rewinding equipment, which means repair and calibration happen under our own supervision rather than at a third party. Our mobile maintenance fleet stays ready to respond around the clock in every Egyptian governorate — because a well that has stopped is not merely a technical fault, it is a growing season at risk.
aboutPage.visionText: To be the first choice in Egypt and Africa for sustainable, intelligent water pumping — advancing the water infrastructure that agriculture, industry and communities depend on.
aboutPage.missionText: To supply genuine, high-quality equipment and engineer solutions that keep water flowing reliably and at the lowest possible energy cost, backed by maintenance that outlasts the installation.

pumpSelector.title: Find the right pump for your duty point
pumpSelector.subtitle: Enter the flow rate and total head you need. We search the full Kurlar 6", 8" and 10" range and recommend the pump running closest to its best-efficiency point — the one that will cost you least to run.
pumpSelector.emptyBody: Enter a flow rate and a head above and we will search 926 pump builds across 27 Kurlar families.
pumpSelector.emptyRangeNote: The range covers flows up to {maxFlow} m³/h and heads up to {maxHead} m.
pumpSelector.matchCountMany: {count} pumps reach this duty point. Ranked by the efficiency each actually runs at, which is what sets the running cost.
pumpSelector.alternativesBody: Every option below also meets your duty point, ranked by published efficiency at your flow rate.
pumpSelector.motorNoOptions: This pump couples to a {bores}" motor, which is outside the KM6–KM10 rewindable range — so no alternative ratings are listed. Kurlar specify {kw} kW ({hp} HP) for this build.
pumpSelector.motorNoExact: Kurlar specify {hp} HP for this build; the KM range does not offer that exact size, so the next size up is selected.
pumpSelector.motorUndersizedWarning: This motor is below Kurlar's recommended {recommended} HP for this pump. Running it here risks overload and motor failure. Confirm with our engineers before ordering.
pumpSelector.motorUpsizedNote: Larger than Kurlar's recommended {recommended} HP. Extra margin for long cable runs or hot climates, at higher cost.
pumpSelector.noMatchTitle: No pump reaches this duty point
pumpSelector.noMatchBestAvailable: At {flow} m³/h the tallest pump in the 6"–10" range delivers {best} m, short of the {target} m you asked for. Staging two pumps in series, or a lower flow rate, would be needed.
pumpSelector.noMatchOutOfRange: No pump in the 6"–10" range is rated for {flow} m³/h. The range covers flows up to {maxFlow} m³/h.
pumpSelector.oversizedNotice: No pump sits within 30% of your head requirement, so these are the closest available. They will over-deliver head — expect to throttle the discharge, and a larger motor than strictly necessary.
pumpSelector.correctedNotice: One or more head values for this model were repaired from a misprint in the Kurlar catalogue. Confirm with our engineers before ordering.
pumpSelector.sourceNote: Performance data from the Kurlar 2025 and KSX catalogues at 50 Hz, taken with clean water at 20 °C (density 1000 kg/m³, 1.013 bar). Actual site performance varies with water temperature, sand content and pipe losses.
pumpSelector.notAdvice: This is a preliminary selection to guide your enquiry, not a final engineering specification.
pumpSelector.invalidInput: Enter a flow rate and a head, both greater than zero.
pumpSelector.chartUnavailable: The catalogue publishes no curve over this range.
pumpSelector.motorOverloadWarning: At your duty point this pump absorbs {shaft} kW, more than the fitted {motor} kW motor can deliver. Choose a larger motor below, or reduce the flow or head.
